verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs state it supports next-day and 2-day payroll processing and handles bank transfers, so the core of fast payroll applies. However, expedited payroll is limited to qualifying companies, and a hands-on report says 2-day payroll was capped at about $60k, requiring repeated support exceptions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of employee (not just contractor) direct deposit as the payment method, clear qualification criteria and limits for next-day/2-day payroll, and independent corroboration that expedited payroll works without caps.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks

citations.quote: Gusto supports next-day, 2-day, and the standard 4-day payroll processing.
Gusto offers expedited payroll for qualifying companies, requiring submission only two business days (2-day payroll) or one business day (next-day payroll) before the check date.
Gusto Embedded does the heavy lifting for you, handling everything from tax calculations to bank transfers.
the 2 day payroll... capped it at something like $60k even when we have millions in the bank account
